verdicts.decision_note: The client concretely requires a removable or flush-cleanable spout for removing matcha and milk residue between uses.
The client expands cleaning and sanitation access from the spout to every liquid-contact component.
The client adds an implementable sanitation rule prohibiting hidden spaces where liquid can collect or become trapped and extends consideration to food-service use.

Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports that the installed internal plumbing can be cleaned by rinsing and occasional bottle-brush access, while noting that it is harder to clean than the rest of the machine.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: For V1, what simple, reliable implementation approach would you use for the spout? It must provide a smooth, controlled pour while remaining easy to clean between uses. A proper seal should prevent liquid from leaking into the base, and the open/close mechanism needs to operate cleanly without dripping.

value_updates.spout_cleaning_requirement: The spout must remain easy to clean between uses.
